name: TerrestrialCarbon
description:
Simulates carbon in three terrestrial pools and the net atmosphere to land CO2 flux,
following the MAGICC7 `TERRCARBON2` subroutine.
It offers three CO2 fertilisation methods and two respiration methods,
with time-varying turnover times, no-feedback reference pools for regrowth
attribution, and a mass conservation correction.
It integrates with an implicit trapezoidal (Crank-Nicolson) method for numerical stability.

# Pools

- Plant biomass (living vegetation)
- Detritus/litter (dead organic matter)
- Soil carbon (long-lived organic carbon)

# Feedbacks

1. **CO2 Fertilisation**: Three blendable methods (logarithmic, Gifford, sigmoid)
2. **Temperature on NPP**: Exponential sensitivity
3. **Temperature on decay**: Separate sensitivities for detritus and soil
4. **Time-varying turnover**: Cumulative deforestation reduces turnover times

# Algorithm

For each step:

1. Extrapolate CO2 to mid-year (quadratic)
2. Calculate CO2 fertilisation factor (3 methods with blending)
3. Calculate temperature feedback factors
4. Calculate NPP and respiration with feedbacks
5. Compute time-varying turnover times
6. Update pools using the implicit trapezoidal method
7. Advance no-feedback reference pools and compute regrowth
8. Apply mass conservation correction

# Nitrogen limitation

With the `nitrogen` parameter, a nitrogen budget limits NPP.
Nitrogen fixation is an input unless fixation is prognostic, when it is an output.

# Inputs

- `Nitrogen Flux|Deposition` (Gt N/yr), only with the `nitrogen` parameter
- `Nitrogen Flux|Fixation` (Gt N/yr), only with the `nitrogen` parameter and no prognostic fixation

# Outputs

- `Nitrogen Flux|Fixation` (Gt N/yr), only with the `nitrogen` parameter and prognostic fixation
- `Nitrogen Limitation Factor` (1), only with the `nitrogen` parameter
- `Nitrogen Pool` (Gt N), only with the `nitrogen` parameter
- `Nitrogen Flux|{Uptake,Recycling,Losses}` (Gt N/yr), only with the `nitrogen` parameter

inputs.name: Atmospheric Concentrations|CO2
inputs.description: Atmospheric CO2 concentration, extrapolated to mid-year for fertilisation

inputs.name: Surface Air Temperature Change
inputs.description: Drives the feedbacks through the warming since `temperature_feedback_start_year`, floored at zero

inputs.name: Emissions|CO2|Biosphere
inputs.description: Biosphere CO2 emissions over the step, taken from the pools as deforestation

outputs.name: Net Atmosphere to Land Flux|CO2
outputs.description: Net atmosphere to land flux over the step, positive for land uptake and including deforestation

outputs.name: Emissions|CO2|Gross Deforestation
outputs.description: Gross deforestation emissions over the step, before regrowth

outputs.name: Carbon Flux|Regrowth
outputs.description: Carbon taken up by regrowth on deforested land over the step

outputs.name: Net Primary Production
outputs.description: Net primary production over the step, with fertilisation and temperature feedbacks

outputs.name: Respiration|Land
outputs.description: Respiration and decay over the step, the NPP that is neither stored nor deforested

states.name: Carbon Pool|Plant
states.description: Carbon in living vegetation at the end of the step

states.name: Carbon Pool|Detritus
states.description: Carbon in detritus and litter at the end of the step

states.name: Carbon Pool|Soil
states.description: Carbon in soil at the end of the step

parameters.name: npp_pi
parameters.description:
Pre-industrial net primary production (MAGICC7 `CO2_NPP_INITIAL`)

unit: GtC/yr

parameters.name: co2_pi
parameters.description:
Pre-industrial CO2 concentration used as reference for fertilisation (MAGICC7 `CO2_PREINDCO2CONC`)

unit: ppm

parameters.name: fertilisation_factor
parameters.description:
CO2 fertilisation factor, $\beta$ in the logarithmic method and also used by Gifford and sigmoid
(MAGICC7 `CO2_FERTILIZATION_FACTOR`)

unit: dimensionless

parameters.name: fertilisation_method
parameters.description: CO2 fertilisation method (MAGICC7 `CO2_FERTILIZATION_METHOD`)

parameters.name: fertilisation_factor2
parameters.description:
Curvature parameter of the sigmoid fertilisation method (MAGICC7 `CO2_FERTILIZATION_FACTOR2`)

unit: ppm

parameters.name: gifford_concentration_for_zero_npp
parameters.description:
CO2 concentration at which NPP would be zero in the Gifford method
(MAGICC7 `CO2_GIFFORD_CONC_FOR_ZERONPP`)

unit: ppm

parameters.name: fertilisation_start_year
parameters.description:
Year before which CO2 fertilisation reference tracks current CO2
(MAGICC7 `CO2_FERTILIZATION_YRSTART`)

unit: yr

parameters.name: npp_temperature_sensitivity
parameters.description:
NPP temperature sensitivity coefficient, $\gamma_{NPP}$ (MAGICC7 `CO2_FEEDBACKFACTOR_NPP`).

unit: K^-1

Positive means warming increases NPP.

parameters.name: respiration_temperature_sensitivity
parameters.description:
Respiration temperature sensitivity coefficient, $\gamma_{resp}$
(MAGICC7 `CO2_FEEDBACKFACTOR_RESPIRATION`).

unit: K^-1

Controls how plant pool respiration responds to temperature.

parameters.name: detritus_temperature_sensitivity
parameters.description:
Detritus decay temperature sensitivity coefficient, $\gamma_{detritus}$
(MAGICC7 `CO2_FEEDBACKFACTOR_DETRITUS`).

unit: K^-1

Positive means warming increases decay rate.

parameters.name: soil_temperature_sensitivity
parameters.description:
Soil decay temperature sensitivity coefficient, $\gamma_{soil}$ (MAGICC7 `CO2_FEEDBACKFACTOR_SOIL`).

unit: K^-1

Positive means warming increases decay rate.

parameters.name: temperature_feedback_start_year
parameters.description:
Year from which warming drives the temperature feedbacks (MAGICC7 `CO2_TEMPFEEDBACK_YRSTART`).

unit: yr

Feedbacks use the warming since this year, floored at zero.

parameters.name: plant_pool_pi
parameters.description:
Pre-industrial plant pool carbon content (MAGICC7 `CO2_PLANTPOOL_INITIAL`)

unit: GtC

parameters.name: detritus_pool_pi
parameters.description:
Pre-industrial detritus pool carbon content (MAGICC7 `CO2_DETRITUSPOOL_INITIAL`)

unit: GtC

parameters.name: soil_pool_pi
parameters.description:
Pre-industrial soil pool carbon content (MAGICC7 `CO2_SOILPOOL_INITIAL`)

unit: GtC

parameters.name: respiration_pi
parameters.description:
Pre-industrial respiration from the plant pool, $R_{h0}$ (MAGICC7 `CO2_RESPIRATION_INITIAL`)

unit: GtC/yr

parameters.name: plant_respiration_fertilisation_scale
parameters.description:
Scaling of fertilisation effect on plant respiration (MAGICC7 `CO2_PLANTBOXRESP_FERTSCALE`).

unit: dimensionless

Plant respiration is $R_h = R_{h0} (1 + \alpha (\beta - 1)) \min(1, C_P / C_{P0}) f_{T,resp}$,
with this scale as $\alpha$.

parameters.name: npp_to_plant_fraction
parameters.description:
Fraction of NPP going directly to plant pool (MAGICC7 `CO2_FRACTION_NPP_2_PLANT`)

unit: dimensionless

parameters.name: npp_to_detritus_fraction
parameters.description:
Fraction of NPP going directly to detritus pool (MAGICC7 `CO2_FRACTION_NPP_2_DETRITUS`)

unit: dimensionless

parameters.name: plant_to_detritus_fraction
parameters.description:
Fraction of plant turnover flux going to detritus (vs soil)
(MAGICC7 `CO2_FRACTION_PLANT_2_DETRITUS`)

unit: dimensionless

parameters.name: detritus_to_soil_fraction
parameters.description:
Fraction of detritus decay going to soil rather than the atmosphere
(MAGICC7 `CO2_FRACTION_DETRITUS_2_SOIL`)

unit: dimensionless

parameters.name: deforestation_plant_fraction
parameters.description:
Fraction of deforestation emissions from plant pool (MAGICC7 `CO2_FRACTION_DEFOREST_PLANT`)

unit: dimensionless

parameters.name: deforestation_detritus_fraction
parameters.description:
Fraction of deforestation emissions from detritus pool (MAGICC7 `CO2_FRACTION_DEFOREST_DETRITUS`)

unit: dimensionless

parameters.name: deforestation_no_regrowth_fraction
parameters.description:
Fraction of deforestation that is permanent, with no regrowth (MAGICC7 `CO2_NORGRWTH_FRAC_DEFO`)

unit: dimensionless

parameters.name: nitrogen
parameters.description: Nitrogen limitation of NPP, off when `None` (MAGICC7 `NCYCLE_APPLY`)
